title: Clifton Hill Fun Pass: Top 6 Attractions
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Make the most of your Niagara Falls visit with this wallet-friendly Fun Pass that gets you into six attractions on Clifton Hill. The entertainment promenade is home to the Niagara SkyWheel, Canada's largest observation wheel. Take a spin on it before or after an 18-hole round of golf at Wizards Golf, a glow-in-the-dark minigolf course or at Dinosaur Adventure Golf; photo ops next to famous folks at the Movieland Wax Museum of Stars; a rollicking ride in an XD theater; a haunted house with laser beam; and a zombie attack adventure with real-time 6D graphics.
